title: How Does AI Pick the Next Word? 100 Real Draws, 26 Different Words #Shorts

beats.narration: Once upon a time, there was a... How does an AI pick the next word? It gives a score to every chip it could write next: a word, or a piece of one. These are real scores from a small AI on my laptop: young gets about thirty percent.

visual.headline: How AI picks the next word
visual.sub: real scores from qwen3.5:4b on a 4 GB laptop (Ollama logprobs)

beats.narration: Then it draws one at random: a higher score is just a better chance. With the extra filters off, I let it draw the first word a hundred times. Young came out thirty times, and twenty-six different words came out in total.

visual.headline: 100 draws, 26 different words
visual.sub: real draws, temperature 1, filters and penalties off

beats.narration: Score, pick, add, repeat: that is how an AI writes. The full explanation, with the code, is on the channel.
